id: title:jabahamondes:resolve legacy stats tables in trend charts

review.posthog_relevance: Adds schema-aware warehouse metadata resolution and compatibility support for Google Ads campaign trend charts, allowing users to retain compatibility with older warehouse schemas while preferring current ones.
review.reason: The implementation in P1.F3.H1 replaces a simple name-based lookup with a schema-aware lookup, using warehouse metadata to resolve the correct table and schema. This demonstrates a substantive, bounded improvement in warehouse connector behavior and compatibility. Documentation and tests support this, but the tier is assigned based on the implementation. No tier assignment is made;
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the implementation, not the broader change group or demonstrated benefit. No tier assignment is made;

observations.limitations: This chunk contains documentation and test changes alongside implementation. P1.F3.H1 shows the implementation of a schema-aware lookup, while P1.F2.H1 and P1.F1.H1 provide supporting documentation and tests. No tier assignment is made here; the score depends on the broader change group and the demonstrated benefit of the implementation.
